title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Pearl Concert Theater, Las Vegas | 2013
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Pearl Concert Theater, part of the Palms Casino Resort in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on 23 November 2013.

It was the final show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s 2013 tour, which lasted for 28 dates between February and November, and the second of two consecutive nights in Las Vegas.

Starr returned to the Pearl Concert Theater on 15 March 2015.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
